EnableDescription: While disabled, the next task run restores every affected user's original tags.
LibrariesDescription: Check none to leave library access untouched. Check some and only those are visible while the rule is active; tag filtering still applies inside them.
ModeAllowOnly: Show only content with these tags
PlaybackStoppedText: This content is outside the allowed schedule.
RulesDescription: Each rule applies to one user on the days you check. Tags are inherited from parent folders and collections, so you can tag a whole folder instead of item by item.
StopPlaybackDescription: Jellyfin does not re-check permissions on a stream that is already open, so without this what was already playing keeps playing. It cuts in when a rule starts hiding what is on screen, not when a slot ends: at the end of a slot the content is allowed again and there is nothing to interrupt.
StopPlaybackLabel: Stop playback when a rule hides what is playing
TagsDescription: In "show only" mode, anything without one of these tags is hidden.
TimeSlotDescription: Leave both at 00:00 to cover the whole day. If the end is earlier than the start the slot runs past midnight, and the checked day is the one it starts on. When slots overlap, the shortest one wins.
WarningMinutesDescription: Minutes of notice before playback is cut. Zero sends no warning. The message only reaches clients that accept remote control.
